rental_applications_decision_recorded.name: rental_applications_decision_recorded
rental_applications_decision_recorded.value: "rental_applications"."status" not in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'CONTRACTING') or ("rental_applications"."decision_reason" is not null and btrim("rental_applications"."decision_reason") <> '' and "rental_applications"."decided_at" is not null and "rental_applications"."decision_source" is not null)

charges_amounts_non_negative.name: charges_amounts_non_negative
charges_amounts_non_negative.value: "charges"."amount_cents" >= 0 and "charges"."rent_cents" >= 0 and "charges"."condo_fee_cents" >= 0 and "charges"."late_fee_cents" >= 0 and "charges"."interest_cents" >= 0 and "charges"."taxes_cents" >= 0 and "charges"."discount_cents" >= 0

lease_amendments_rent_change_complete.name: lease_amendments_rent_change_complete
lease_amendments_rent_change_complete.value: ("lease_amendments"."new_rent_cents" is null) = ("lease_amendments"."previous_rent_cents" is null) and ("lease_amendments"."new_rent_cents" is null or ("lease_amendments"."effective_from" is not null and "lease_amendments"."new_rent_cents" >= 0))

payments_provider_required_with_id.name: payments_provider_required_with_id
payments_provider_required_with_id.value: "payments"."provider_payment_id" is null or "payments"."provider" is not null
